PLAN "12-Week Beginner Strength Program (Home: mat + doorway bar) Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational full-body strength safely at home"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - Focus: establish movement patterns, acclimate to training, build work capacity
      - Weekly cadence: 3 training days (Mon/Wed/Fri) plus mobility and home cardio
      - Keys: moderate RPE, basic loaded squats, push-ups, rows, hip thrusts; core work; light cardio
    WEEKS:
      - Week 1: Foundation A (Mon) | Foundation B (Wed) | Core & Mobility (Fri)
      - Week 2: Foundation A/B variants with similar structure
      - Week 3: (repeat with small progressive tweaks)
      - Week 4: deload or maintain volume with focus on form

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - Focus: increase push intensity and overall workload while maintaining form
      - Weekly cadence: 3 training days; continue mobility; introduce progressive overload strategies
    WEEKS:
      - Week 5: Progression A (Mon) | Progression B (Wed) | Volume & Stability (Fri)
      - Week 6: continue progression with adjusted reps/sets
      - Week 7: mid-phase check-in, adjust loads if needed
      - Week 8: peak within Phase 2, prep for Phase 3

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - Focus: strength apex and broader exercise variety; heavier sets and maintained recovery
      - Weekly cadence: 3 training days; Saturday finisher; mobility routine; cardio
    WEEKS:
      - Week 9: Strength Apex A (Mon) | Apex B (Wed) | Apex C (Fri); Saturday finisher remains
      - Week 10: continued heavy sets with accessory work
      - Week 11: tapering volume slightly while maintaining intensity
      - Week 12: final testing or reassessment and deload

WORKOUT STRUCTURE OVERVIEW
  DAILY STRUCTURE (typical)
    - Warmup: 5–10 minutes (light cardio and mobility)
    - Main straight_sets: 3–4 exercises, 3–4 sets, 6–12 reps (per exercise)
      - Rep ranges: 3x8..12, 4x6..8, etc. as per phase
      - RPE targets: generally 7–8 for primary lifts; adjust by phase
      - Rest: 60–120 seconds between sets depending on exercise
    - Cardio_home: short home cardio blocks on some days
    - Mobility_routine: post-workout mobility (hip flexors, thoracic spine, shoulders)
    - Finisher (Saturday): 20-minute playful finisher with bodyweight tempo and short sprints
  SATURDAY FINISHER
    - 3 rounds of 20s work / 20s rest for a circuit including sprint-in-place, burpees (or incline push-ups), mountain climbers, and tuck jumps (or knee-tap jumps)
    - Purpose: build work capacity, add a fun, low-barrier high-intensity element

NUTRITION INTEGRATION
  - Protein target: 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight daily
  - Calorie target: maintenance ± 250–350 kcal for gradual strength gains
  - Meal timing: pre-workout snack; post-workout protein within 1–2 hours
  - Hydration: 2.2–3.0 liters per day
  - Flexible templates and week-by-week progression across phases (Phase 1 focus on protein/hydration, Phase 2 adjust calories for gradual weight gain, Phase 3 refine portions and fiber)

  - home routines for warmups/cooldowns: walking, jogging in place, jumping_jack, high_knees
  - optional: skip rope, stair steps, brisk march
  - sustainability: options to substitute with walking or stationary movement when limited space
